items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Jelly at the piano was there... I said, is that what you call yourself? ... He said, this is me, Jelly Roll

ctx.x: Yeah, we played player for the June prom

dance at Princeton University out at Princeton, New Jersey, Jelly at the piano was there, and Jelly (unintelligible) Martin and his Hot Peppers and so and so and so. You know how the students are. So they drink. Well, after we had intermission, say, hey, I want to know who is this guy Jelly Roll Martin. So we said, the piano player. Well, these students are funny, you know. They walk up and say, hey, Mr. Jelly Roll. Jelly Roll said, yeah. This is me (unintelligible), the king of the jazz, this was the jingle of…
He said, this is me, Jelly Roll, said, well, you ain't nothing. Oh, no (unintelligible).
